extracted.intended_audience: New York Times employees (newsroom and corporate staff) and the public interested in the company's journalistic standards
extracted.subtask_description: A company-level collection of standards and guidance governing New York Times journalism, employee conduct, social media engagement, reader-comment moderation, and advertising acceptability. The page indexes handbooks and guideline documents that set expected behavior and practices for News and Opinion departments and all employees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trust of our readers
rubrics_metrics.description: The trust of our readers is essential. We renew that trust every day through the actions and judgment of all our employees — in our journalism, in our workplace and in public.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Establishes the overarching principle that employee actions and judgment (on- and off-duty) must sustain reader trust; underpins the subsequent, specific guidelines listed on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ethical Journalism Guidebook
rubrics_metrics.description: A handbook of values and practices for the News and Opinion departments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Serves as the primary reference on journalistic values and newsroom practices for reporters, editors, and opinion writers; summarizes expected ethical behavior and decision-making in news and opinion coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guidelines on Our Integrity
rubrics_metrics.description: Additional ground rules on basic newsroom practices
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides supplemental, concrete rules and clarifications about day-to-day newsroom procedures and integrity-related matters that supplement the main guidebook.

rubrics_metrics.name: Social Media Guidelines for the Newsroom
rubrics_metrics.description: Newsroom protocol for engaging responsibly on social media.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies expectations and protocols for journalists' and newsroom accounts' use of social platforms to ensure responsible engagement, protect impartiality, and preserve trust.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guidelines for Reader Comments
rubrics_metrics.description: Moderation principles for encouraging civil discourse within our community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets moderation standards and principles intended to foster civil, constructive conversation in reader comment sections and to guide moderators' decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Our Code of Conduct
rubrics_metrics.description: The standards by which all Company employees are expected to conduct themselves.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A company-wide code that defines acceptable employee behavior, conflict-of-interest expectations, and professional standards applicable beyond the newsroom.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advertising Acceptability Guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: An overview of standards for advertising.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines what types of advertising content are acceptable to run with the Times' journalistic content, outlining boundaries intended to maintain editorial integrity and reader trust.
